abstract.p: Methods and systems are disclosed which relate to online bill management via interface surfaces printed with information and coded data. The coded data, encoded visibly or invisibly, may be queried by an appropriate sensing device. The sensing device communicates with a computer system. Together, the interface surfaces, sensing device and computer system are capable of effecting online bill management, including bill payment, over a network.

L'invention porte sur des procédés et des systèmes relatifs à la gestion de factures en ligne via des surfaces d'interfaces sur lesquelles sont imprimées des informations et des données codées. Il est possible de consulter les données codées, de manière visible ou invisible, à l'aide d'un dispositif de détection approprié qui communique avec un système informatique. Les surfaces d'interface, le dispositif de détection et le système informatique réunis peuvent effectuer sur un réseau la gestion des factures en ligne telle que paiement de factures.

BACKGROUND

A bill management service allows a bill payer to view, pay, and otherwise manage their bills over the Internet The bill payer can notify their regular billers to redirect bills to their bill manager The bills may be sent in traditional paper form by mail or may be sent electronically
A regular notification of due bills is typically sent to the bill payer by e-mail over the Internet The bill payer can then select which bills to pay, how much to pay, and what payment method to use

OBJECT It is an object of the present invention to combine advantages of paper-based bills and online bill management

Secret-key cryptography, also refeπed to as symmetnc cryptography, uses the same key to encrypt and decrypt a message Two parties wishing to exchange messages must first arrange to securely exchange the secret key
